item.text: {"candidates":[{"query_id":"q05","reason":"Uses filtered aggregation and HAVING to preserve qualifying route counts, NULL grouping keys, and the BIGINT count type.","sql":"SELECT PULocationID AS pickup, DOLocationID AS dropoff, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) AS trips FROM trips GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7) > 0"}]}
